name: 3D Haar Wavelet Enumeration
aliases: 3D Haar Wavelet Decomposition for Virtual Sculpture
Discrete multiresolution model based on 3D wavelets
definition: A multiresolution representation of a 3D object using 3D Haar wavelets, allowing extraction of different levels of detail (LOD) from a most detailed level (e.g., 128^3 voxels) down to coarser levels (e.g., 64^3, 32^3).
summary: 3D Haar Wavelet Enumeration encodes 3D objects into hierarchical wavelet coefficients to enable accelerated display and virtual sculpture by extracting specific levels of detail.
